email.subject: Gentle Group Dentistry: two quick site issues
email.body:
Hi Kofi,

I checked Gentle Group Dentistry's site and noticed it's not optimized for mobile, which likely costs you new-patient calls since most local searches happen on phones. On top of that, there's no click-to-call button, so mobile visitors who do find you have to manually dial instead of tapping to call.

The page title is also weak for search (doesn't clearly say "dentist in Harbor Falls"), which may be hurting your visibility in local search.

I fix these for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough this week showing exactly what's losing you patients?

Alex
Northlight Web
